newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, swaps, bonds hold in late dealing.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, swaps, bonds hold in late dealing.

text.p: Greek interbank deposits, forex forwards and bonds were steady in late Friday dealings but there was some buying interest for three-year fixed coupon bonds, dealers said.
"Trading in depos is thin. Forex forwards are stable in narrow trading, around the 10.80 level for the one-month swap and 10.65 for the one-year swap" a state bank dealer said.
The central bank kept its intervention rate in overnight money unchanged at 11.90 percent.
"It looks as if it will remain constant next week too," the dealer said.
Bonds were stable, trading around late Thursday levels a foreign bank bond dealer said.
"Most market interest was focused on the three-year fixed coupon bond and there was active trading around the 98.5 level," the dealer said.
After a month of stability, the bond market expects prices to start rising soon, the dealer added.
The mark was quoted at 157.52/62 from Friday's 157.550 fix, the dollar at 266.68/78 drachmas from 266.460 and the Ecu at 305.72/82 from 305.500 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is steady trading at 305.50-55, late on Friday. This was close to its fixing rate, as there was no particular interest during the day," a foreign bank forex dealer said.
